metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC, at least 0.50 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20 and the frozen v1.7 candidates
metadata.availability_policy: BaoStock peTTM observed at the trade-date close is available only for next-session execution.
metadata.proxy_policy: The signed reciprocal of BaoStock dynamic peTTM is an operational earnings-to-price proxy. It is not an exact reconstruction of the paper's most recently disclosed net profit excluding nonrecurrent gains and losses.
metadata.negative_earnings_policy: Retain finite negative 1/peTTM values so loss-making firms remain on the growth side, matching the paper's factor-portfolio treatment; zero or missing peTTM remains missing.
metadata.revision_policy: BaoStock exposes the current historical snapshot and no valuation revision vintages. Historical evidence remains RESEARCH_ONLY.

fd896b2dbe4091e8.factor_description: Signed earnings-to-price proxy derived from BaoStock daily dynamic PE at the trade-date close.
fd896b2dbe4091e8.factor_formulation: 1 / query_history_k_data_plus.peTTM for finite nonzero peTTM; zero or missing peTTM is missing

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, firms with higher earnings relative to price earn higher next-period returns than firms with lower or negative earnings relative to price.
metadata.paper_factor_difference: The source paper uses the latest disclosed net profit excluding nonrecurrent gains and losses and monthly portfolio formation; this candidate uses BaoStock dynamic peTTM inside the existing frozen two-day-label strategy solely to test incremental software value.

feedback.reason: Registered after a two-code schema-only probe and after earlier project returns were viewed, but before any full E/P synchronization, E/P cross-section, or E/P return result was viewed.

consistency_check.hypothesis_to_description: Both define higher signed earnings-to-price as the value direction.
consistency_check.description_to_formulation: The reciprocal converts lower positive PE to higher E/P and retains negative E/P without a performance-chosen cap or transform.
consistency_check.formulation_to_expression: The expression directly reads the immutable Provider field derived by the declared formulation.
consistency_check.overall_feedback: The candidate is a documented BaoStock proxy rather than an exact paper replication; semantic acceptance is not performance acceptance.
